Updated the existing Treasury Bulletin yields skill with the generalizable lesson:

Fisher Ideal symmetric growth for yield questions must be computed directly from the printed monthly values at full precision, with no intermediate rounding of the product/square-root or percent conversion. Near-boundary values can shift the third decimal; e.g. around -0.11335 rounds to -0.113, not -0.114.

Also updated memory to flag Fisher yield calculations as full-precision-final-rounding only.
